flag.note: Aqua fronts over a Sierra-oak worktop warm up a north-facing kitchen - a good call for low-light rooms.

reviews.title: Brightened the whole flat
reviews.body: The aqua fronts give our kitchen a holiday feel every morning, and the handleless grip rail is so clean to wipe down.

reviews.title: Lovely colour, oak ties it together
reviews.body: Aqua with the Sierra oak worktop looks even better in person. One star off only because we waited a while for delivery.
reviews.author: Markus, Hamburg

reviews.title: Exactly like the XR preview
